title: task complete on a Paused task fails with 'unconfigured status' and names neither the status nor the way out
description: Observed 2026-09-27 closing QCLI-388 on quest 0.11.0: `quest task complete` on a Paused record exits 6 with "Task transition uses an unconfigured status." Paused is configured (task status-flow reports pausedStatus "Paused"), so the message is wrong about the cause and gives no remedy. `task start` then `task complete` works. Whether complete should accept Paused directly is a design question and out of scope here. This task is only about the refusal naming the from-status and pointing to `quest task start <id>`.

acceptanceCriteria.text: task complete on a Paused task refuses with a message that names Paused as the current status and names quest task start <id> as the way back
A test covers the Paused-to-complete refusal text and exit code
